plugins.name: assets
plugins.description: Provides the configuration, metadata, and session-discovery skills for sollertia-shared-assets, the asset backbone of the Sollertia platform. Authors and validates every shared asset, owns the library's registry-backed extension path, and serves the Unity Editor relay. Backed by the sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa).

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Provides Unity Editor integration skills for the sollertia-virtual-reality project. Generates VR tasks from templates, manages scenes and Play Mode, and drives the Unity Editor relay. Backed by the sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa) through the assets plugin, which it requires.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Provides the acquisition-system design, hardware interface, runtime, and library-extension skills for sollertia-experiment and sollertia-micro-controllers. Covers the system-agnostic core for building and operating a data acquisition system, with system-specific skills in a companion plugin such as mesoscope. Backed by the sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle).

plugins.name: mesoscope
plugins.description: Provides the Mesoscope-VR reference acquisition system, the worked example an agent copies when implementing a new system. Covers its acquisition runtime and configuration, its shared-asset record schemas, and the processing donations it makes to sollertia-forgery. Requires the assets, experiment, and forging plugins and their MCP servers.

plugins.name: forging
plugins.description: Provides the data processing and dataset forging skills for sollertia-forgery, which turns recorded sessions into per-session data tables and multi-session datasets. Covers batch processing across all six pipelines, job planning, dataset composition, remote SLURM execution, and the library's extension path. Backed by the sollertia-forgery MCP server (slf).
